assets.summary: Standard garrison starts REDCON at 4, updates alert state on hostile identification/sensing/overlap/building changes, wakes configured spawns and posts patrol/guard jobs. limitations: Uses shared native awareness and job machinery. Faction dialogue differences are not proof of separate ally/enemy locomotion AI. Lower REDCON numeric values mean higher alert through the base subtracting increase method.

assets.summary: Base encounter component connects overlap/attitude dispatch, relevant GUID lookup, awareness subscriptions, unit lifecycle and job-board transfer. Increase REDCON subtracts and Decrease adds, passing Min=1 and Max=MinimumREDCON to Clamp. Activation delegates to reinforcements; base hooks mostly return false; setup conditionally binds observers. Default tick capability is false.
limitations: MinimumREDCON defaults to 0, so a valid Clamp interval depends on initialization; standard garrison separately initializes it to 4. Native sensors/spawn helpers and shared function-library bodies are dependencies. Return booleans do not universally summarize side effects; ActivateUnitsForJobs returns HasActivated=false despite a post call.

assets.summary: Dispatch base configures wave-locator decks, transfers units, handles hotdrop ground/air capacities and queues vehicle spawns on a grid. Grid uses default 16 spots and per-call cell size; team information is applied at call sites. Remaining units fall through to parent activation.
limitations: Queued spawn is not an observed spawn. No universal player-exclusion distance is established. One wave-locator MoveUnitData path supplies the created encounter as both self and destination, requiring a targeted trace before assigning effects.

assets.summary: UnitActivationType has independent Spawned, InGarage and InReinforcementDrop flags; Spawned tooltip explicitly excludes job assignment.
